chibi-undead-monument.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD
chibi-undead-monument.notes: Reused candidate 13 of the Undead Explorer sheet (explorer-a), no new PixelLab job: the obelisk recipe obelisk-a was not run, as the bead's US$5 limit left no room for another call. A tall slender pale slate obelisk on a low plinth, two columns of violet glowing gems up its faces and ivory bone trim round its foot; no compass rose, no spyglass and no other achievement's motif, so it shows the Undead builder and hides the achievement. Lit from the left. Other compass-free pieces of the sheet: 6 (a bone and scroll at its foot), 9 (carved runes and a skull, busier), 12 (a bone cage at its foot).

chibi-undead-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD:CONQUEROR
chibi-undead-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 3 of 16: a small arch of pale slate on two thick pillars with an open gateway, a wreath of ivory bone leaves on its lintel and a small violet glowing skull on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath in Undead slate and bone, lit from the left. 1, 2 and 6 are close; 5, 9, 10, 12 and 15 have no wreath; 7 a chain of bones; 8 iron spikes.

chibi-undead-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD:ENGINEER
chibi-undead-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 0 of 16 (resumed after a dropped poll): a square pale slate pillar topped by a big ivory bone cogwheel standing on its edge, a crossed dark iron hammer and spanner on its front; the Engineer's cog and crossed tools in Undead slate and bone, lit from the left. 2, 8, 9 and 13 are close (13 with violet flames, 2 a violet gem); 3, 6 and 7 no tools; 4 violet crystals at its foot.

chibi-undead-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD:EXPLORER
chibi-undead-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 2 of 16: a pale slate-blue obelisk with a round ivory bone compass rose with a violet glowing centre on its front, a dark iron spyglass and a few bones at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass in Undead slate, bone and violet, lit from the left. 4 and 11 a loose violet star, not a rose; 1, 3 and 9 a skull and no rose; 12 a cage; the rest lose the rose or the spyglass.

chibi-undead-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD:LAND_BARON
chibi-undead-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 1 of 16: a stout slate boundary stone with a carved skull on its front, an ivory bone crown with a violet gem on its flat top and a crooked charcoal signpost with two arrow boards; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost in Undead slate and bone, lit from the left. 10 is close; 2 and 7 carved bones or runes, not a shield; 5, 8 and 15 violet flames in the crown; 13 dark stone.

chibi-undead-monument-muster.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:UNDEAD:MUSTER
chibi-undead-monument-muster.notes: Candidate 3 of 16: a tall pale slate pillar hung with a round dark iron shield, a charcoal kite shield, a square shield rimmed with bone and a small bone buckler, with a curved ivory bone war horn at its foot; the Muster's four shields and horn in Undead slate, iron and bone, lit from the left. Every candidate puts the horn at the foot, not across the top; 6 and 10 have one or no shield.
